weak_references.why: owner: a capability that passes every gate is never withheld for a weaker reference (2026-10-23)
weak_references.note: passed every gate; the reference is weaker than an independent computation (see notes)

notes.aero_stall_speed: brentq re-solves L = W at CL_max (the defining equation); only the density is independent (fluids' US 1976 atmosphere)
notes.aero_level_flight_lift_coefficient: brentq re-solves L = W for CL (the defining equation); only the density is independent (fluids)
notes.aero_wing_loading: W/S in exact sympy arithmetic with scipy's constants: the definition restated
notes.aero_induced_drag: Trefftz-plane quadrature of the elliptic loading, divided by e: the span-efficiency scaling is restated
notes.aero_glide_range: the steady glide integrated in time (DOP853 with an event): the definition R = h L/D restated
notes.aero_rocket_thrust: the exit momentum flux by quadrature plus the pressure force: the thrust equation restated
notes.aero_ballistic_coefficient: m/(CD A) in exact sympy arithmetic: the definition restated
notes.aero_flight_condition: M, q, EAS and Re are definitions; only the atmosphere (speed of sound, density, viscosity) is independent (fluids' US 1976)
